name: ChatBoard
description: Conversation-driven chart dashboard for DBX: tell an AI agent what you want and it adds chart cards to a persistent board via MCP tools.
releaseNotes: Initial release of ChatBoard: persistent chart board with 5 chart types, shape-based auto inference, and MCP tools (list_boards/add_card/remove_card) so AI agents add cards through conversation. Windows-x64 native sidecar.

zh-CN.name: 对话图表看板
zh-CN.description: 用对话直接生成图表的 DBX 看板插件：对 Agent 说一句话，即通过 MCP 把查询结果变成可保存的数据卡片。
